title: Company formation and banking
summary: Company setup, banking, and compliance resources for founders building in any ecosystem.

links.description: Form a Delaware C-Corp or Wyoming LLC, open a US business bank account with USDC treasury, and invoice in stablecoins and fiat. Corporate documents include bylaws, RSPAs, 83(b) filing, cap table, and indemnification agreements, with US and cross-border compliance support including India. Colosseum builder perks: 30% off incorporation, priority EIN processing, priority banking KYB, and a free 30-minute entity setup call.
